title: Decision: draft-mahy-cbor-edn-for-tls-01 is track-only for mimid (could help vectors)
description:
Assay mimid-1wgh.44.19 of /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-cbor-edn-for-tls-01.txt (672 lines, read whole; sha256 in specs/PROVENANCE).

What it is: a convention for writing TLS-presentation-language instances as CBOR EDN: structs as maps keyed by field name, opaque as byte strings, other vectors as arrays, enums as integers with a comment, optional<T> as {present, value}, select arms by presence, framed by '# ~~~ tls <Struct>' (§3). Informational (L7). No codepoints.

How it meets mimid: none at runtime. It could make test vectors readable (mimid's joint IETF 127 vectors and fixtures are hex in JSON), but only once tools read it; none exist that mimid uses.

RECOMMEND: track only. Spec defects: wg bead (shared with cbor-pointer's).
